body: Independent cloud comparison evidence for this existing owner, without competing implementation: pinned Buster `d4ca72fb4e97ae0a410b0d03258b00495fa45e13`, trusted Clang Release build on hosted Ubuntu26.04, run [37005042712](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/37005042712), oracle Ubuntu GCC15.2.0-16ubuntu1. Source: `int a[-1];`. With explicit GNU11, baseline ISA and non-PIC semantic flags, Buster `-fsyntax-only` exits0 with no diagnostic; `-c` exits1 with `C code generation refused: kind=codegen.invalid-ir ... function='<none>' opcode=unknown`. GCC rejects both with `size of array 'a' is negative`. `gcc-comparison-evidence/probes.json` retains exact argv/status/output; ZIP SHA256 `619d7c825ece0752362c9f62b56195da2e3641c29e007026c1226ee5ef4642e4` verified after download. Untimed behavior is valid despite that run's rejected wall-time samples. Respects the active `/root/triage_components` claim and planned `codex/1568-negative-array-bound-diagnostics`; no source edit or branch claim here. Comparison owner #2274. License/provenance: Buster first-party project license remains unselected at the inspected revision (LICENSES/README.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; #621). GCC compiler GPL-3.0-or-later; this uses GCC as an oracle and copies no compiler source.
